  "report": "Stage comparison treats P00–P42 in the supplied pre-addition list as initial evidence, and P08–P13 plus R01 as additions.\n\nInitial: Packaging attracts praise for appearance, refillability and perceived environmental merit. P00’s chic/environmentally friendly statement has 296 displayed likes; P15’s intended empty-container reuse has 150. These show resonance with those statements, not verified sustainability, reuse or purchasing effects. Several distinct accounts praise packaging, but share one brand-owned TikTok thread. P02 questions recyclability; P03’s qualified answer is from P00’s own author, and P01 is brand agreement. Environmental performance remains unverified. P26 praises packaging while asking what the product does for skin.\n\nInitially, P06 alone reports arrival leakage with a loose top, cleanup and concern about oxygen exposure. P07 offers a replacement and says short exposure is not an issue; this is brand reassurance, not independent evidence of product integrity or completed remedy. Initial requested counts are arrival_leak 1, explicit_loose_top 1, bare_arrival_agreement 0, replacement_offered 1, replacement_sent 0, retailer_leak 0 and repurchase_intended 0.\n\nUpdated: Seven distinct focal TikTok accounts report or contextually agree to arrival leakage: P06, P08–P13. Three provide more than bare agreement: P06 describes the loose top and cleanup; P08 adds Sephora ordering and a free replacement reportedly sent; P13 describes an improperly screwed top and major leak after ordering from Sephora. Four are terse agreements. Thus arrival leakage has distinct-account recurrence within one reply branch, with unequal detail; only P06 and P13 independently describe a loose/improperly screwed top. Their raw likes are respectively 12 and 0; P08 has 5, and bare agreements have 4, 4, 2 and 0. Zero likes do not negate testimony. These are account counts, not verified independent-human or event counts. Complaint SKU/version remains unknown, and agreement cannot supply every detail of P06’s experience.\n\nR01 separately reports Softwear–Void’s lid repeatedly unscrewing during use, including leakage in a work pocket, stained clothing and unrecoverable product. This adds retailer-review evidence of leakage and closure problems at a broader level, but does not corroborate arrival failure for the unidentified TikTok product. It is one account reporting recurrence, not a count of separately established incidents. Its proposed click-lock or doe-foot changes are suggestions, not implemented remedies.\n\nConsequences: P07 offers service replacement; P08 reports Sephora sent one free, without delivery confirmation. R01 explicitly intends to repurchase because Void is a favorite despite product loss, expense and strong packaging dissatisfaction; the review is 3/5 and recommends the product. P17 reports an all-Experiment routine and Continuum in transit, but attributes neither to packaging. P20 expresses broad buying enthusiasm without confirming completed purchases. P32 may save up; P38 wants to try; P42 reports receipt and only then discovering refillability, so that discovery cannot explain the already-completed acquisition. P04/P27 request refill bundles, P29 asks about a refill sticker, and P15 proposes reuse; these do not establish repeat purchases.\n\nReception is mixed across dimensions: aesthetic/refill enthusiasm coexists with functional complaints and complaint alongside loyalty. There is no direct rebuttal of the specific leak reports, but no basis for a general defect rate, failure mechanism, safety conclusion or packaging-driven buying effect. General praise does not establish leak-free use. Product/formula versions are unavailable; named Continuum/Super Saturated requests and Softwear–Void testimony must not assign those products to unspecified comments. No joint-use evidence resolves complaint scope.\n\nAll TikTok observations are from the same video, captured 2026-09-09T11:56:25.935Z; displayed publication dates lack years. The capture contains 47 displayed bodies against 72 advertised comments, with only the specified branches expanded, so completeness is bounded. Native comment IDs are unavailable. R01 was published 2026-05-10; review-level engagement is unavailable, and product-wide ratings are not endorsement of its complaint. No separate context records were supplied. Likes establish neither experience, independence, prevalence nor buying consequences. The buying-case action counter is inapplicable.",
